jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
About Fundcraft

fundcraft is a fast-growing, tech-powered fund services provider, aiming to revolutionise the fund management industry through our proprietary platform. Our dedicated team of financial experts, lawyers, tech developers, and data scientists are fully committed to turning the organisation to a leading fund services firm, in Europe and beyond. The company was founded in 2020 and has been experiencing rapid growth, already employing more than 75 professionals in two countries.

About The Role

Key responsibilities:
• You will collaborate with a cross-functional scrum team that develops in Python, ReactJS, Docker and AWS Cloud technologies
• You will design, build and maintain API’s, services and systems across fundcraft’s engineering teams
• You will collaborate in improving engineering standards, tooling and processes

How you will be successful in your application

Must-Have Experience / Qualifications
• You have at least 1 year of experience working as a Backend... Engineer
• Experience in the development, deployment, and maintenance of web-based technology applications with Python or the ability and interest in working with it
• Devotion to clean and well-done code
• Spanish: fluent level (spoken and written)
• English: fluent level (spoken and written)

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with other elements of fundcraft's tech stack: Django, Celery, OpenAPI, Javascript, React, PostgreSQL, AWS
• Experience working with Agile methodologies

What you will get in return

A culture where you can thrive..
• An entrepreneurial culture encouraging creativity and innovative, disruptive ideas,
• A diverse and fast-paced work environment and the ability to interact with/learn from a wide variety of specialists,
• A multicultural team promoting our corporate values of Ownership, Transparency, Team spirit, Boldness,
• Workplace automation and application of new technologies across workflows.

Benefits To Support You In Your Journey..
• Internal training and career development opportunities,
• Stock options offerings - our success is your success,
• Flexible working hours, home working options, attractive package after 1 year,
• Ergonomic work equipment and spacious, modern offices located in Girona(We are 5 min walk from the train station)

Selection process
• Stage 1: Video interview with our HR department (45 min)
• Stage 2: Meet the Team: interview with the hiring manager and a senior member of the team (45 min)
• Stage 3: Interview with a member of the management team or another member of the team (Optional) (45 min

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Back-end (PHP)
jobs_results.description:
¿Te apasionan los viajes🛫, la cultura🗽, el ocio🎡 y tienes ganas de participar en el crecimiento de la empresa Nº 1 en servicios turísticos en español? Nuestro equipo no para de crecer y buscamos personas con talento e ilusión por desarrollarse. Somos un equipo joven, multicultural e innovador que entiende cada día como un desafío y una nueva oportunidad para crecer junto con la empresa.

Si quieres conquistar el mundo con nosotros, ¡te estamos esperando🚀💥!

Buscamos a tres personas para incorporarse a nuestro Departamento de IT como Senior Backend PHP en nuestras oficinas de Madrid (Gran vía).

¿Cómo será tu día a día?
• Apoyo al equipo de IT.
• Desarrollo de las herramientas de gestión internas y externas para la plataforma.
• Mantenimiento de nuestra web.
• Transformación digital (proyecto de nuevas funcionalidades y best practices).

¿Qué buscamos?
• Es fundamental la experiencia y conocimiento de PHP, 4 o 5 años como mínimo (a partir de la versión 7 en adelante).
• Es... fundamental la experiencia en uso de algún framework php, tales como laravel, symfony, slim u otro.
• Es fundamental poder realizar trabajo presencial en Madrid (Gran Vía).
• Conocimientos de DDD, TDD y/o arquitectura hexagonal.
• Orientación a producto o experiencia en e-commerce.

¿Por qué Civitatis?
• Formarás parte del líder mundial de reserva online de excursiones y visitas guiadas en español💃🏽.
• Espíritu joven, viajero y gran ambiente de trabajo. ¡20 nacionalidades🌏🌎!
• Trabajo presencial (en nuestras oficinas de Madrid, Gran vía) y días de teletrabajo. Flexibilidad horaria, jornada intensiva de verano y medidas de conciliación.
• ¡23 días laborables de vacaciones más tu día de cumpleaños!
• Eventos de teambuilding (desayunos, paddel, senderismo, etc.)
• Nunca dejarás de aprender. Planes de desarrollo y formación continua.
• ¡Equipo sano, equipo feliz! Tenemos fruta siempre a mano 🍌🍊 y clases de yoga gratuitas🧘🏽🧘🏽♀️.
• Podrás disfrutar de nuestras más de 88.000 actividades con un super descuento.
• Formación continua (Codely y LKD Learning).
• Trabajarás en el corazón de Madrid. Oficinas junto a la Puerta del Sol.

¿Te sumas? ☺️☺️☺️

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

MultiSafepay is a cutting-edge fintech company that has been revolutionizing the payment industry for over two decades. As a leading Payment Service Provider, we specialize in developing innovative in-house solutions for a diverse range of merchants. Recognized as the top-ranked company in the "Emerce 100" Payment Service Provider category, we provide seamless and secure payment experiences for our clients. Join our dynamic team at our international office in beautiful Estepona, Málaga, and be a part of our journey towards global success.

About the Role: As a Perl Developer at MultiSafepay, you will play a crucial role in our Development team and collaborating with the Operations team, Business Analysts, and Product Managers. You will be responsible for handling risk, monitoring systems, and onboarding processes. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled Perl developer to work on challenging projects, contribute to the migration of projects, and make a... significant impact on our fintech solutions.

Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain Perl-based applications and systems to handle risk management, monitoring, and onboarding processes.
• Collaborate with other developers, and cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features and functionalities.
• Assist in the migration of projects from Perl to other languages, such as Java, while ensuring the smooth operation and transition of systems.
• Contribute to code reviews and provide valuable insights to uphold coding standards and best practices.
• Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies to drive innovation and enhance our products.

Job requirements
• Proven work experience as a Perl Developer, with a deep understanding of Perl programming language.
• Familiarity with risk management, monitoring systems, and onboarding processes is a plus.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Operations, Business Analysts, and Product Managers.
• Experience with migration projects is highly desired.
• Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies, including Java, if required.

At MultiSafepay, we are a team of passionate professionals who strive for excellence. We value a collaborative and inclusive working environment, where every team member's input is respected and appreciated. Our culture is characterized by innovation, teamwork. We believe in continuous learning and offer opportunities for professional growth, along with a competitive salary package and health insurance benefits. Located near the beautiful beach of El Saladillo, our modern office provides a dynamic atmosphere with opportunities for cross-training and extra-office activities like gym access and free Spanish classes.

Ready to Join? If you are a Perl developer who thrives on exciting challenges and wants to make a significant impact in the fintech industry, MultiSafepay is the place for you. Don't worry if you're open to exploring Java or other languages, we're here to support your professional growth. So whether you're a Perl expert or a Java enthusiast willing to dive into the world of Perl, we encourage you to apply and become a valuable member of our team. Help us shape the future of international payment solutions and grow both personally and professionally

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer (Beca)
jobs_results.description:
¿De qué va la empresa en la que trabajarás?

Somos Slashmobility, una empresa de soluciones móviles corporativas, llevamos más de 12 años centrados en el objetivo acelerar la digitalización tecnológica de la sociedad, como si esto no fuera suficiente, en este tiempo ha sido el lugar donde más de 70 personas han hecho realidad más de 1000 proyectos para 150 clientes con presencia nacional e internacional.

¿Y qué nos hace especiales?

Nos basamos en cuatro valores fundamentales:
• Innovación, ofreciendo soluciones innovadoras de una manera profesional y rentable con un valor diferencial: el conocimiento experto en toda la cadena de valor;
• Compromiso ya que llevamos como propios los objetivos de la organización y superamos cualquier obstáculo para lograrlos;
• Proactividad, proveyendo y realizando acciones para mejorar sus servicios y calidad;
• Trabajo en equipo, contando con un equipo motivado y multidisciplinar que trabaja en perfecta coordinación para lograr los objetivos... comunes.

Requisitos:
• Desarrollo de proyectos relacionados con backend.
• Posibilidad de crear convenio con una Universidad o escuela de formación.
• Disponibilidad para venir a oficina tres días por semana

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador de back-end
jobs_results.description:
En SEREM estamos comprometidos con diversos proyectos y queremos contar con los mejores profesionales del sector. Nos encontramos en búsqueda activa de un/a Desarrollador Backend para trabajar en importante compañía internacional ubicada en Málaga.

Functions:

Develop and maintain applications for German retailer Group.

Design, implementation, quality assurance and documentation of the code

Code responsible from the very beginning until production environment

Participation in the design of software architectures and the selection of technologies.

Work closely together with a German product team (English mandatory)

Technical Requirements:

Experienced in Java 8+ development and related frameworks such as Spring Boot.

Practical experiences in software development and working in a development team.

Good testing practices (Unit testing, Junit, Mockito, automated testing).

Experienced practices in some Database development (SQL, Hibernate, Hadoop, Db2, HBase). Good problem-solving... skills and starving to keep learning and touching new languages/frameworks

You live in Spain, and you have a valid permit work /VISA.

Verbal and written advance knowledge of the English language.

Desired requirements

Kotlin and Linux shell experience.

Experience with Apache Kafka, Kubernetes and/or GCP.

Experience using Big Data tools such as Yarn and Apache Drill.

Knowledge of German language.

What we offer:

• A startup-like culture with fascinating opportunities, combined with the security of being part of a major corporate force in the Group.

• Challenging tasks but also a tech playground.

• Work in a modern office, fostering creativity, collaboration, and agility.

• A flexible, autonomous work environment where your ideas will contribute to our collective success.

• Open communication culture in an international environment with steady growth, and more to come!

Our Benefits

• Hybrid work (at least once a month on site) and flexible working time

• Private health insurance

• Ticket Restaurant

• Professional development opportunities: English/German courses, and further IT education/trainings

• 23 days paid vacation

Fomentamos un ambiente de trabajo multicultural e inclusivo, no discriminamos por edad, género o creencias; así como ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades a todo el personal.

Desarrollamos nuestras actividades bajo los principios del cuidado del medioambiente, la sostenibilidad y la responsabilidad social corporativa; colaborando en proyectos de reforestación y sostenibilidad.

Apoyamos los 10 principios del Pacto Mundial y los 17 Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible, en materia de derechos humanos, condiciones laborales, medio ambiente y anticorrupción.

Los procesos de reclutamiento se desarrollan bajo altos estándares de calidad definiendo la incorporación en base a la experiencia y habilidades del candidato.

Somos una empresa española líder en servicios tecnológicos y atracción del talento presente en el mercado desde 1995. Contamos con más de 600 empleados en proyectos tanto nacionales como internacionales en sector TI

jobs_results.title: Back-End Developer
jobs_results.description:
¿Cómo será tu día a día?

- Analizar, diseñar, desarrollar y probar los desarrollos funcionales y técnicos a partir de las instrucciones y la hoja de ruta del responsable.

- Monitorizar el rendimiento de los desarrollos desplegados, identificando ineficiencias y oportunidades de mejora.

- Aplicar las normas de seguridad determinadas como buenas prácticas en el desarrollo.

- Asegurar la calidad en el desarrollo, verificando que el software cumple con los requisitos determinados y produce el resultado deseado.

- Realizar acciones para la actualización y el mantenimiento de las aplicaciones desarrolladas, atendiendo a las sugerencias y errores identificados por el usuario final.

¿Qué esperamos de ti?

- Deseable formación profesional superior, ingeniería relacionada con Software (Telecomunicaciones, informática, etc.)

- Experiencia en desarrollo con Node.js

- Experiencia mínima de dos años en posiciones similares.

¿Cuál es nuestro propósito?

Contribuir al desarrollo de la... tecnología para generar energía limpia que ayude al medio ambiente guiados por nuestros valores de Excelencia, Innovación, Flexibilidad y Sostenibilidad.

¿Qué nos hace especiales?

- Te ofrecemos un proyecto estable.

- Horario flexible.

- Servicio de autobús gratuito Valencia- Campus Lliria.

- Seguro médico privado cubierto por Power Electronics.

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Who is DEKRA? Since its foundation in 1925, the DEKRA promise has been to ensure the safety of human interaction with technology and the environment. The company currently employs around 52,000 people in more than 60 countries on all five continents. With qualified and independent expert services, they provide safety on the road, at work and at home.

We have a clear and ambitious vision of the future. The vision for our 100th birthday in 2025 is to see DEKRA as the global partner for a safe world.

On this ocassion, an exciting opportunity has arisen in our DIGITAL & PRODUCT SOLUTIONS Division. This area is to focus on tech competencies and drive digital innovation to help leading DEKRA into a successful future.

You want to know more? Here we go!

Role position:

We are currently looking for a Backend Developer to strengthen our Big Data Team.

About Big Data Team:

DEKRA offers value to companies through technology, with solid, innovative, flexible and efficient IT products and... services, focused on the digitization needs of companies, providing improvements in their business and decision-making processes. The Big Data & Analytics solutions are based on specialized methodologies and software tools that enable the collection, analysis, and selection of large amounts of data, transforming it into useful information for management processes, decision making, new service development, and business opportunity identification.

Requirements:
• Experience with REST APIs and WebServices.
• Solid hands on working with Spring Framework (Security, MVC, SpringData, Spring Boot and Spring Cloud).
• Experience with Microservices.
• Comfortable using SQL (experience with NoSQL databases is a plus).

Additional Requirements:
• GIT and Maven experience.
• Knowledge of JIRA.

Desirable:
• Knowledge of containers (Docker, Kubernetes…).
• Messaging with Kafka/RabbitMQ.

Profile:
• Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or similar.
• Deep Knowledge in Object Oriented Programming and developing with Java applications.
• Written and spoken English and Spanish.
• Customer-focused attitude.

Benefits include:
• Flexible and dynamic working environment.
• Hybrid role position: Possibility to 3 remote days each week after trial period. Besides, flexible arrival and lunch time.
• Opportunities for continuous learning and upskilling.
• Flexible retribution with possibility of private health insurance, restaurant and kindergarten vouchers.
• Permanent contract in a multinational with a long history.
• Joining a multicultural team where you will feel like a member from day one.
• Help you drive towards your goals.

What is the location of the position?
• Málaga, Madrid or Barcelona (hybrid mode).

Let's consider that we have an interesting project and we want you to be part of it. Don't hesitate, join our team

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
TransPerfect is an established company with a start-up culture seeking creative entrepreneurial people like you to join our team. We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join our global team to be responsible for the quality, development, and execution of our software products.

About TransPerfect:

TransPerfect helps organizations navigate the global marketplace. It remains founder-led – and has striven to maintain the ethos and drive that led them to grow organically year-on-year for the past 30 years. Starting in an NYU dorm room in the early 1990s, TransPerfect is now recognized as the largest translation and language services company in the world. From offices in more than 90 cities on six continents, TransPerfect offers a full range of services in 170+ languages to clients worldwide.

You will be part of a technology department that is comprised of a successful and multidisciplinary group of professionals located across the globe – Barcelona, New York, London, Manchester... Bucharest and India. If you’re ready to join a growing company and make an immediate impact, we want to hear from you!

About the team you will be joining at TransPerfect – TechOps:

The TransPerfect TechOps team has been a vital part of the company’s success since its formation 10 years ago – delivering technology and services that have drastically simplified the lives of our clients and colleagues – from workflow improvements for colleagues to core services that form the basis of the company’s GlobalLink platform, to creating scalable client interfaces that allow novice users to navigate complex ecosystems.

To learn more about our solutions, please visit: https://globallink.transperfect.com/

Your responsibilities and tasks will include:
• Develop and maintain backend services and APIs to support our applications on both web and mobile
• Collaborate with cross-functional made up of product managers, quality assurance teams, designers and other developers to translate business requirements into technical solutions
• Implement scalable and efficient algorithms and data structures to optimize performance
• Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, consistency, and adherence to best practices
• Debug and troubleshoot issues to identify root causes and implement effective solutions
• Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve our backend infrastructure
• Contribute to the design and architecture of new features and enhancements
• Collaborate with Front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic
• Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to mitigate and address issues
• Develop automation tests/ collaborate with automation engineers to ensure business needs are met, and allow for regression testing
• Work closely with users to provide personalized software support as needed
• Document application support and operational procedures

The minimum we’re looking for (show us what you got if you aren’t a perfect fit):
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, or related field
• 3+ years of software development experience
• Deep knowledge of DotNet C#, MSSQL, Entity Framework and related technologies
• Proven experience of Agile methodologies like SCRUM/Kanban
• Knowledge of SOLID principles
• Knowledge of clean code practices
• Ability to work with complex enterprise software architectures
• Database Development in SQL Server or NoSQL Databases
• Some familiarity of Docker
• Experience debugging complex applications
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment
• Azure, AWS, RabbitMQ and Quartz experience is a plus

Work model:

This position is intended to be largely in-office with a focus on flexibility. Today, most of the global team is on a hybrid model ranging between 3-4 days in the office per week. We aim to find an inclusive balance between everyone's personal lives and responsibilities and the value created from in-office collaboration. We work with new team members to find that balance with them while building the trust and collaboration that our team values.

We believe that sharing the same physical space with our colleagues creates a level of trust and understanding that fosters innovation and a sense of purpose.

The socializing and relationships formed from these in-person interactions have created the bonds that make our team successful.

We not only want to encourage people to safely spend time in the office, but also, schedule regular travel between our offices in Europe and the US – and a regular conference where the entire worldwide team is gathered together. Maybe the Metaverse will replace the office some day – but it hasn't yet! Online meetings were a powerful connector during the pandemic – but they don't foster the same connection.

By applying, I confirm I have read and accepted TransPerfect's Privacy Policy: https://www.transperfect.com/about/data-privacy-recruiting

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador de back-end | Experto en Wordpress
jobs_results.description:
En DominioZero estamos buscando un perfil de desarrollo backend y experto en Wordpress para incorporación inmediata a nuestro equipo de desarrollo web.

Qué buscamos en ti:
• 💻 Conocimiento profundo y avanzado de BBDD.
• 🤓 Experto en WordPress (se valora positivamente conocimiento y experiencia en otros CMS como PrestaShop y Magento).
• 🕸️ Experiencia en la gestión de hosting, haciendo lanzamientos y migraciones de páginas web
• 🔧 Experiencia realizando mantenimientos para webs, dando soporte y atención al cliente.
• 👨💻 Experiencia en programación de plugins y funcionalidades a medida para páginas web en Wordpress
• 💙 Conocimiento del paquete de Atlassian (Jira Software).
• ⏩ Capacidad para resolver incidencias e imprevistos.
• 📚 Capacidad y actitud de formación continua, carácter curioso y autodidacta.
• 🤝 Experiencia en trabajo en equipo y coordinación de diferentes proyectos de forma simultanea.

Vale, ¿Y quienes sois?

Somos una agencia pequeña, familiar, muy cañera y... disfrutona.

Nos encantan los retos, somos muy autoexigentes e intentamos que cada proyecto nuevo supere las expectativas de nuestros clientes.

Siempre estamos buscando superar nuestros propios limites, nos encanta estar a la ultima y hacer que nuestros clientes se enamoren de nuestro trabajo.

Con esto quiero decir que como desarrollador, no te vas a aburrir ni un minuto.

Lo que te ofrecemos
• 💸 Salario competitivo negociable en función de experiencia.
• 🔝 Capacidad de crecer y desarrollar tu perfil, demostrar tu valía y aplicar a puestos de liderazgo.
• 🤘 Ambiente de trabajo agradable y distendido: Está mal que lo digamos nosotros, pero te rodearás de gente que siempre estará dispuesta a echarte una mano
• 🏠 Teletrabajo ocasional: Si lo necesitas, podrás teletrabajar desde casa de forma ocasional, siempre que nos avises con antelación.
• 🙏 Confianza y cercanía: No somos una big tech ni creemos en estructuras verticales de organización, si necesitas algún día libre o cambiar el horario algún día, sólo es cuestión de hablarlo.
• 👨🎓 Formación constante: Creemos que la formación es fundamental, por eso si quieres continuar formándote contaras con nuestro apoyo.
• ⏳ Horario flexible: El horario habitual suele ser de 09:00 a 17:00, el viernes tarde libre, pero si lo necesitas, tendrás la posibilidad de modificar el horario
